summary.name: Dot
summary.one_liner: Dot is an AI data analyst that answers data questions for teams, delivering insights inside Slack, Microsoft Teams, or email.
use_cases: answering data questions from a team chat
getting quick business insights without SQL
sharing analytics within Slack or Teams
summary.what_it_does: Dot is presented as an AI data analyst that answers data questions for a team. Users can get insights where they already work, namely in Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email. The page says it aims to give everyone instant, actionable insights. The page names customers such as Choco, Duolingo, Emerge, and KRY, and claims it is trusted by 100+ top teams. It does not describe the underlying data sources, query mechanics, or setup steps.
notable: Answers data questions inside Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email
Positioned for whole teams rather than only analysts
Page offers a Start for Free call to action
caveats: Page does not describe details of paid tiers or limits beyond a free start option
Technical capabilities, supported data sources, and security details are not stated on the page
